arguments.command:
cd /workspace/task && md5sum scratch/log.jsonl > /tmp/before.md5 && python3 - <<'EOF'
import json
codes=[]; invalid=[]
with open('scratch/log.jsonl','rb') as f:
    raw=f.read()
text=raw.decode('utf-8')
lines=text.split('\n')
if lines and lines[-1]=='': lines=lines[:-1]
for i,line in enumerate(lines,1):
    if line.strip()=='':
        continue
    try:
        obj=json.loads(line)
    except Exception:
        invalid.append(i); continue
    if isinstance(obj,dict) and obj.get('level')=='error':
        codes.append(obj.get('code'))
with open('scratch/errors.json','w',encoding='utf-8') as f:
    json.dump({"codes":codes,"invalid_lines":invalid},f,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)
    f.write('\n')
print(codes,invalid)
EOF
md5sum -c /tmp/before.md5; cat scratch/errors.json
